# Pricing, invite expiry, and internationalized display names

Label: needs-triage

## Problem Statement

The guestlist service has outdated Pro pricing, invites do not expose an expiry date, and the current display-name formatting removes non-ASCII characters. Arabic guest names therefore appear blank or incomplete. The Team price remains unchanged at 40; an earlier proposed increase to 45 was explicitly cancelled.

## Solution

Update the Pro plan price to 15 while keeping the Team plan at 40. Add an `expires_at` value to every invite, calculated as 14 days after creation. Update display-name formatting so Arabic names and other supported Unicode names remain readable while preserving the existing trimming and title-formatting behavior where appropriate.

## User Stories

1. As a Pro customer, I want the Pro plan to cost 15, so that displayed and calculated pricing matches the current plan decision.
2. As a Team customer, I want the Team plan to remain 40, so that the cancelled price increase is not applied.
3. As a customer using seat-based pricing, I want Pro and Team totals to use the current per-seat prices, so that multi-seat quotes are accurate.
4. As an invite sender, I want each created invite to have an `expires_at` value, so that the invitation's validity window is explicit.
5. As an invite recipient, I want my invite to expire 14 days after it is created, so that stale invitations are no longer treated as current.
6. As an operator, I want expiry to be calculated from the invite creation time, so that clock-dependent behavior is deterministic and auditable.
7. As an operator, I want the invite's existing name, email, phone, and creation data preserved, so that adding expiry does not regress invite storage.
8. As a guest with an Arabic name, I want my name displayed in Arabic, so that I am correctly identified in the guest list.
9. As a guest with a Unicode name, I want display formatting to preserve supported characters, so that international names are not blanked or silently corrupted.
10. As a guest-list user, I want long names to remain bounded by the existing display limit, so that layout remains stable without losing all non-Latin content.
11. As a maintainer, I want pricing, expiry, and display-name behavior covered by externally observable tests, so that future changes catch regressions.

## Implementation Decisions

- Update the plan-price source so Pro is 15, Team is 40, and Free remains unchanged.
- Preserve the existing seat-multiplication contract for price calculation.
- Extend the invite data model with `expires_at`.
- Set `expires_at` to the creation timestamp plus 14 days when an invite is created.
- Use the service clock for both timestamps so tests and callers can supply deterministic time.
- Preserve existing invite collection and notification integration behavior.
- Replace ASCII-only display conversion with Unicode-safe handling that retains Arabic characters.
- Preserve trimming, maximum display length, and reasonable title casing behavior where those operations do not damage the user's script.
- Keep the work limited to pricing, invite expiry data, and display-name formatting; no separate Team pricing change is included.

## Testing Decisions

- Test Pro pricing and multi-seat calculation using the updated value.
- Test that Team pricing remains 40, including the existing multi-seat behavior.
- Test invite creation stores an `expires_at` exactly 14 days after the injected creation time.
- Test that existing invite fields remain intact after adding expiry.
- Test Arabic display names remain non-empty and preserve their characters.
- Test existing Latin display-name formatting continues to work.
- Test the display-length boundary with Unicode input to ensure truncation does not cause decoding errors or erase the name.
- Prefer black-box tests of public pricing, invite-service, and display functions, following the existing unit-test style.

## Out of Scope

- Raising the Team plan price to 45; that proposal was withdrawn.
- Changing the Free plan price.
- Adding invite revocation, renewal, or background cleanup jobs.
- Changing notification transport behavior or message content.
- Redesigning the guest-list UI or introducing a broader localization system.

## Further Notes

The final corrections in the request are authoritative: invite expiry is 14 days, not 7; Team remains at 40. No application code has been changed in this workflow.
